info.title: VisitTrinbago Admin Place Import API
info.description: Authenticated XLSX preview and draft-only place imports. Existing listings are never overwritten. Preview responses contain private source notes. See admin-import-api.md for workbook layouts, count semantics and cURL examples. Use the actual development or production host as the server URL. Custom single-admin authentication uses environment ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD (at least 16 non-padding characters) with SESSION_SECRET (at least 32 non-padding characters). Retain the shared existing session secret if valid. Sessions issued before auth hardening or credential/secret rotation require a new login after the change. Browser writes must be same-origin; headerless non-browser clients and read-only requests are supported.

servers.description: Host of the intended admin environment

post.description: Regenerates the session ID and sets the HTTP-only connect.sid cookie bound to the current configured admin credentials. Reuse it for import requests; log in again after auth hardening or credential/secret rotation. No API-key or Bearer-token support. Browser writes must be same-origin. The bounded process-local login limit permits five attempts per client IP in 15 minutes; counters are not shared across server instances.

email.description: Admin sign-in email; surrounding whitespace and case are normalized.

Set-Cookie.description: Session cookie. Value is sensitive; retain in a protected cookie jar.

429.description: Bounded process-local login rate limit reached. Wait for Retry-After before retrying.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying login.

example.message: Too many login attempts. Try again later

503.description: Login unavailable because admin environment configuration is missing or invalid. Public reads remain available; an operator must correct the configuration.

example.message: Admin login is unavailable: valid admin credentials must be configured

post.summary: End the session and clear its cookie
post.description: Send the session cookie to end that session. This endpoint does not require an authenticated session. Browser writes must be same-origin. Session-store destruction failure returns 500 even though the cookie is cleared.

500.description: Session-store destruction failed; the cookie is cleared but server-side session invalidation is not confirmed.

get.description: Returns at most 50 summaries, newest first. No pagination wrapper or preview-row retrieval.

get.summary: Download a blank Places XLSX template

200.description: Workbook containing a Places worksheet and supported headers.

post.summary: Upload and persist a private import preview
post.description: Raw XLSX bytes only; not multipart, JSON or base64. Maximum 5,242,880 bytes, 40 MiB expanded archive and 2,500 candidate rows, with additional archive/worksheet safety checks. Supports the Places template and TTL multi-sheet layout. Does not create listings. Empty or unsupported sheets may yield an empty preview.

parameters.name: X-File-Name
parameters.description: URL-encoded filename ending in .xlsx. Server retains the basename, truncated to 200 characters.

200.description: Private persisted preview. Keys can be selected for commit.

413.description: Workbook exceeds the 5 MiB upload limit.

415.description: Request body was not parsed as raw XLSX with the required media type.

post.summary: Create hidden drafts from selected preview rows
post.description: Transactionally rechecks duplicates and never overwrites existing places. Finalizes the entire batch, including when zero drafts are created. Unselected rows count as skipped. Repeating a finalized batch returns original counts and alreadyImported=true; upload again to select previously omitted rows.

200.description: Committed batch result; does not publish any places.

adminSession.name: connect.sid
adminSession.description: Admin session cookie set by POST /api/auth/login and validated against the current configured credentials. Legacy sessions and sessions issued before credential/secret rotation cannot authenticate; log in again after the change. Not a manually issued API key.

BadRequest.description: Invalid payload, filename, workbook, batch identifier or selection. Inspect message for details.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, expired or legacy admin session, or session issued before credential/secret rotation. Log in again after hardening or rotation.

BrowserWriteForbidden.description: Browser write rejected because Origin/Referer is cross-origin or Sec-Fetch-Site is same-site/cross-site. Use the same admin origin. Read-only requests and headerless non-browser clients are allowed.

keys.description: Opaque keys from this batch's preview. Duplicate keys are accepted and processed once.

skippedCount.description: Parser-excluded rows + unselected candidates + commit-time duplicates/conflicts.

alreadyImported.description: Present and true when the batch was finalized previously; original counts are returned.

key.description: Opaque stable import identity. Submit unchanged.

verified.description: Source is the verified worksheet, not approval to publish.

rawColumns.description: PRIVATE original source values, including possible staff notes. Never send publicly.

existingId.description: Present when matched to an existing place; selected matching rows are skipped at commit.

interest.description: May be blank; review before publishing.

subInterest.description: May be blank; review before publishing.

description.description: May be blank; review before publishing.

rewardPoints.description: Currently initialized to zero for imported rows.

metadata.description: Mapped category-specific fields. Does not include raw spreadsheet provenance.

category.description: Null for the category-per-row Places template or excluded sheets.

rows.description: Rows processed in this sheet before final cross-sheet deduplication; not an imported count.

reason.description: Present when the sheet is excluded or unsupported.
